color.note: Two first-class themes. Holo stops live on lines and edges only. Every text token's note names the grounds it reads on; all pairs meet WCAG AA in both themes.

tokens.name: background
tokens.usage: App canvas behind everything: the message column and page body.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Panels that sit on background: sidebar, inspector, cards at rest.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards and controls that lift off surface (composer, stat tiles, code block header). Pair with shadow-raised.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Wells inside a surface: code blocks, input tracks, the context bar trough.

tokens.name: surface-overlay
tokens.usage: Translucent fill for popovers, menus, sticky headers and sheets. Always with backdrop blur 12px and a hairline border.

tokens.name: surface-hover
tokens.usage: Hover wash for rows, ghost buttons and menu items. Layer over any surface.

tokens.name: surface-active
tokens.usage: Pressed or selected wash: active thread row, selected menu item.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Backdrop behind dialogs and mobile sheets.

tokens.name: foreground
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on background, surface, surface-raised and surface-sunken. 15:1+ in both themes.

tokens.name: foreground-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: metadata lines, labels, cost strip, timestamps. 6.2:1+ on every surface in both themes.

tokens.name: foreground-subtle
tokens.usage: Tertiary text: placeholders, group headings in the sidebar, axis labels. 4.6:1+ on every surface in both themes. Never for numbers the user acts on.

tokens.name: foreground-inverse
tokens.usage: Text on an inverse fill such as a tooltip or toast.

tokens.name: inverse
tokens.usage: Inverse fill for tooltips and toasts. Pair with foreground-inverse.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Default 1px hairline: card edges, dividers, table rows, sidebar edge. Decorative only, never the sole marker of a control.

tokens.name: border-subtle
tokens.usage: Faintest rule: grid texture, ruler minor ticks, row separators inside dense tables.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Control outlines that must be seen (input, checkbox, radio, switch track, outline button). 3:1+ on every surface in both themes.

tokens.name: ring
tokens.usage: Solid 2px focus ring under every holo-ring. 4.5:1+ on every surface in both themes, so focus stays visible when the holo layer is off.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Solid brand amber: primary button fill, links, active tab underline, selected checkbox. Text in accent reads on every surface (4.5:1+).

tokens.name: accent-hover
tokens.usage: Primary button hover and link hover.

tokens.name: accent-foreground
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an accent fill. Never put white on dark-mode accent.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted amber wash: selected segmented item, brand badge, to-be-written chip ground. Text on it is accent-strong.

tokens.name: accent-strong
tokens.usage: Amber text on accent-soft (5.8:1 light, 7.7:1 dark).

tokens.name: holo-cyan
tokens.usage: Holo gradient stop 1. Lives on strokes and edges only, never as a text or surface fill.

tokens.name: holo-violet
tokens.usage: Holo gradient stop 2. Strokes and edges only.

tokens.name: holo-pink
tokens.usage: Holo gradient stop 3. Strokes and edges only.

tokens.name: holo-amber
tokens.usage: Holo gradient stop 4, the brand amber inside the spectrum, so the sheen flows out of the brand color. Strokes and edges only.

tokens.name: holo-glow
tokens.usage: Soft outer glow behind vivid holo strokes. Transparent in light mode on purpose: foil on paper does not glow.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Positive outcomes: saved, connected, positive savings. Teal leans blue so it never relies on a red-green split with danger; always pair with an icon or word. Text in this color reads on every surface (4.5:1+).

tokens.name: success-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted ground for success banners, chips and inline messages. Text on it uses success (4.8:1+ both themes).

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Needs attention soon: budget at 80%, cache cooling, cache-break warning. Text in this color reads on every surface (4.5:1+).

tokens.name: warning-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted ground for warning banners, chips and inline messages. Text on it uses warning (4.8:1+ both themes).

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Destructive or blocked: delete, budget paused, provider error, negative savings. Always with an icon and words. Text in this color reads on every surface (4.5:1+).

tokens.name: danger-foreground
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a solid danger fill (danger button): 6.6:1 light, 7.9:1 dark.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted ground for danger banners, chips and inline messages. Text on it uses danger (4.8:1+ both themes).

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Neutral notices: checkpoint created, tips, keepalive explained. Text in this color reads on every surface (4.5:1+).

tokens.name: info-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted ground for info banners, chips and inline messages. Text on it uses info (4.8:1+ both themes).

tokens.name: cached
tokens.usage: Tokens read from cache: cheap, good. Inspector layer chip, cached share of the context bar (solid fill), '87% cached' in reply metadata, hit-rate line.

tokens.name: cached-soft
tokens.usage: Ground for the cached chip. Text on it is cached.

tokens.name: to-be-written
tokens.usage: One-time cache write cost (the next message writes this layer). Context bar uses a diagonal hatch in this color so it differs by texture, not hue alone.

tokens.name: to-be-written-soft
tokens.usage: Ground for the to-be-written chip. Text on it is accent-strong.

tokens.name: fresh
tokens.usage: Tokens billed at full input price, uncached. Context bar uses an outlined segment; chip says 'fresh'.

tokens.name: fresh-soft
tokens.usage: Ground for the fresh chip. Text on it is fresh.

tokens.name: cache-warm
tokens.usage: Cache is warm: the next send will hit. Dot fill plus the holo ring on the cache indicator.

tokens.name: cache-cooling
tokens.usage: Cache is within 60s of its 5 minute expiry. Draining ring in this color, calm, never blinking.

tokens.name: cache-cold
tokens.usage: Cache expired or never written. Plain neutral dot: cold is a fact, not an error.

tokens.name: budget-ok
tokens.usage: Daily spend under 80%. Progress stroke in the usage header.

tokens.name: budget-near
tokens.usage: Daily spend at 80% to 99%. Soft banner with warning-soft ground.

tokens.name: budget-paused
tokens.usage: Daily spend at 100%: sending paused until override. Banner with danger-soft ground.

tokens.name: savings-positive
tokens.usage: Net savings above zero. Always prefixed with a plus or 'saved'.

tokens.name: savings-negative
tokens.usage: Net savings below zero (keepalive cost more than it saved). Always prefixed with a minus sign, never color alone.

tokens.name: chart-1
tokens.usage: Chart series 1 (cyan). Derived from Okabe-Ito and tuned to the holo stops. 3:1+ on surface in both themes. Use in order; always pair with a legend label, and use chart-6 for 'other'.

tokens.name: chart-2
tokens.usage: Chart series 2 (amber). Derived from Okabe-Ito and tuned to the holo stops. 3:1+ on surface in both themes. Use in order; always pair with a legend label, and use chart-6 for 'other'.

tokens.name: chart-3
tokens.usage: Chart series 3 (violet). Derived from Okabe-Ito and tuned to the holo stops. 3:1+ on surface in both themes. Use in order; always pair with a legend label, and use chart-6 for 'other'.

tokens.name: chart-4
tokens.usage: Chart series 4 (vermillion). Derived from Okabe-Ito and tuned to the holo stops. 3:1+ on surface in both themes. Use in order; always pair with a legend label, and use chart-6 for 'other'.

tokens.name: chart-5
tokens.usage: Chart series 5 (orchid). Derived from Okabe-Ito and tuned to the holo stops. 3:1+ on surface in both themes. Use in order; always pair with a legend label, and use chart-6 for 'other'.

tokens.name: chart-6
tokens.usage: Chart series 6 (warm gray). Derived from Okabe-Ito and tuned to the holo stops. 3:1+ on surface in both themes. Use in order; always pair with a legend label, and use chart-6 for 'other'.

tokens.name: code-fg
tokens.usage: Code block default text on surface-sunken. Syntax theme, 4.5:1+ on surface-sunken in both themes.

tokens.name: code-comment
tokens.usage: Comments. Syntax theme, 4.5:1+ on surface-sunken in both themes.

tokens.name: code-keyword
tokens.usage: Keywords, storage, control flow. Syntax theme, 4.5:1+ on surface-sunken in both themes.

tokens.name: code-string
tokens.usage: Strings and template literals. Syntax theme, 4.5:1+ on surface-sunken in both themes.

tokens.name: code-number
tokens.usage: Numbers, booleans, constants. Syntax theme, 4.5:1+ on surface-sunken in both themes.

tokens.name: code-function
tokens.usage: Function and method names. Syntax theme, 4.5:1+ on surface-sunken in both themes.

tokens.name: code-type
tokens.usage: Types, classes, tags. Syntax theme, 4.5:1+ on surface-sunken in both themes.

tokens.name: code-punct
tokens.usage: Punctuation and operators. Syntax theme, 4.5:1+ on surface-sunken in both themes.

families.mono: "Geist Mono", "JetBrains Mono", ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, monospace

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Sign-in hero and empty states only. One per screen.

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: Section and panel headings, dialog titles, H2 in replies.

styles.name: subheading
styles.usage: Card titles, H3 in replies, settings group names.

styles.name: prose
styles.sample: The cache keeps the first 12k tokens, so this reply only paid full price for your last message.
styles.usage: Assistant and user message bodies. Max width 70ch (layout-message).

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Keepalive refreshes the cache while you read.
styles.usage: Default UI text: settings, dialogs, form help.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.usage: Dense UI: thread titles, menu items, table cells, tooltips.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Form labels, button text (md/sm), tabs, segmented items.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Sidebar group headings, chips, legend text, badge text.

styles.name: overline
styles.usage: Uppercase micro-labels on the inspector and usage tiles. Use sparingly.

styles.name: mono-hero
styles.usage: Stat tile values and the inspector total. tnum on, ligatures off.

styles.name: mono
styles.usage: Code blocks and inline code. Ligatures off so -> and != read literally.

styles.name: mono-sm
styles.usage: Cost strip, reply metadata, layer row prices, token counts. tnum on.

styles.name: mono-xs
styles.usage: Ruler ticks, chart axes, code block language label, kbd.

spacing.note: 4px base. Comfortable density for reading, compact for data panels (see layout tokens).

tokens.name: space-0
tokens.usage: Reset.

tokens.name: space-px
tokens.usage: Hairline offsets, holo stroke width.

tokens.name: space-0.5
tokens.usage: Icon-to-text nudges, focus ring offset.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Chip padding-y, gap inside kbd groups.

tokens.name: space-1.5
tokens.usage: Gap between icon and label in buttons sm.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Button gap, compact row padding-x, metadata separators.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Control padding-x (md), inspector row padding-x.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding (compact), composer inner padding.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card padding (comfortable), sidebar padding-x.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between messages from the same side; section gaps in panels.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between turns; page padding on desktop.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Large section spacing on settings and usage.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Empty state padding, header height.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Sign-in card offset, hero spacing.

radius.note: Nested radius = outer radius minus padding. Four working steps plus pill.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Kbd, inline code, checkbox, chips inside controls, chart bar tops.

tokens.name: radius-control
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, selects, segmented control, menu items, tooltips.

tokens.name: radius-popover
tokens.usage: Popovers, dropdown menus, toasts, code blocks.

tokens.name: radius-card
tokens.usage: Cards, composer, stat tiles, inspector sections, user bubble.

tokens.name: radius-dialog
tokens.usage: Dialogs and sheets (top corners only on mobile sheets).

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Badges, cache indicator, switch, avatars, branch switcher.

shadow.note: Lines first. Shadows are soft and few; dark mode adds a top inner highlight instead of more blur.

tokens.name: shadow-none
tokens.usage: Flat: everything sitting on background or surface.

tokens.name: shadow-raised
tokens.usage: Raised: composer, stat tiles, code block. Plain hairline border.

tokens.name: shadow-floating
tokens.usage: Floating: popovers, menus, tooltips, toasts. Hairline border; holo edge only when it holds a live or selected thing.

tokens.name: shadow-modal
tokens.usage: Modal: dialogs and sheets. Subtle holo edge on the dialog frame.

layout.note: Widths and densities used by the app shell.

tokens.name: layout-sidebar
tokens.usage: Sidebar width on desktop. Becomes a sheet under 900px.

tokens.name: layout-message
tokens.usage: Max width of the message column text (about 680px in prose).

tokens.name: layout-composer
tokens.usage: Max width of the composer and cost strip.

tokens.name: layout-inspector
tokens.usage: Inspector panel width. Becomes a bottom sheet under 1200px.

tokens.name: layout-header
tokens.usage: Header and sidebar top bar height.

tokens.name: row-comfortable
tokens.usage: Row height in comfortable density: thread list, settings rows, menus.

tokens.name: row-compact
tokens.usage: Row height in compact density: inspector layers, usage table, legend.

tokens.name: control-sm
tokens.usage: Small control height (button sm, segmented in composer).

tokens.name: control-md
tokens.usage: Default control height.

tokens.name: control-lg
tokens.usage: Large control height (sign-in, dialogs on mobile).

tokens.name: z-sticky
tokens.usage: Sticky headers, composer dock.

tokens.name: z-sheet
tokens.usage: Mobile sidebar and inspector sheets.

tokens.name: z-popover
tokens.usage: Popovers, menus, tooltips.

tokens.name: z-dialog
tokens.usage: Dialogs and their scrim.

tokens.name: z-toast
tokens.usage: Toasts, above everything.
